offer.text: The watch burns through arrows faster than I can fletch them, and another dark night's coming. Bring me sixteen arrows and I'll see the wall stays stocked.

accept.text: Good. An archer without arrows is just a fellow holding a stick.

decline.text: Then the quivers run dry, and the wall with them.

in_progress.text: How's that bundle of arrows coming?

ready.text: Sixteen good shafts — that'll keep the watch loosing till dawn.

complete.text: The wall's well supplied, thanks to you. Steady hands keep the village standing.
